positions.title: Authorized Officer (Lead Associate)
positions.description:
Universal Document Imaging System designed to provide document scan and indexing service to retail branches and different business areas within UBS Wealth Management.
System is developed using RAD, JAVA 1.5, Struts, WebServices, applet, DB2 and Websphere 6.1 application server.
Designed and developed OCR (Optical Character Recognition) Web Services to convert scan/fax images into the searchable pdfs and provides these pdfs to the various downstream systems for further review.
Day to day activities and responsibilities includes supporting all retail branches (around 350), talking to business users for enhancements and QA users for testing issues, working with technical/architect team for upgrading underlying technologies.

Designed and enhanced the New Accounts Imaging Workflow system to support the single signature document form which comprises of multiple clients and accounts, greatly reducing the amount of paperwork and time to approve the accounts.

Heavily involved in writing technical specifications and performed requirements analysis, application design, and development of the New Accounts Imaging Workflow system by using WebSphere, DB2, IBM workflow and IBM Content Manager. Application is based on Model View and Controller (MVC) pattern and followed J2EE architecture.

Designed Business Object Model which involved class diagrams, activity diagrams and sequence diagrams using Microsoft Visio.

Designed and developed Java objects to interact with DB2 database objects using JDBC connection, MQ and present the data to users using JSP.

Involved in regression, integration, unit and performance testing.

Communicate with QA and Business users to solve the QA and performance related issues.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Performed requirements analysis, application design, and development of the e-Vigilance system for the pharmaceutical clients to keep track of the drug’s sample distribution and inventory by using WebLogic as an application server, Oracle as a database server. 

Wrote shell scripts, back-end packages, stored-procedures, functions, and triggers using Oracle 9i.

Wrote PL/SQL code to generate flat files from the daily transaction activities and scheduling it to run every night using shell scripts and transfer output files to the client’s FTP site.

Created PL/SQL tables in stored procedure to temporary store the data during the processing time and returns the data using ref cursors.
Created indexes, functional indexes, and text indexes on the tables for optimizing queries.

Designed and developed JSPs, Struts XML files, application resources file and business logic classes.

Used Struts logic Tags, bean Tags, HTML Tags and Template Tags libraries.

positions.title: Web/Database Developer (Graduate Assistant)
positions.description:
Designed and developed Cooperative-Education Internship Program.

Performed system requirements analysis and application design.

Created functional specifications for web pages, reports layouts and back-end server processes.

Provided support and training on the system for the employees.

Monitored website information, uploading program materials on website for 24 hour/7 day per week access by students, faculty, and employers.
